name: Quartz movement
summary: A timekeeper in which a quartz crystal vibrates at a fixed rate, and a circuit counts the vibrations to move the hands or to show digits.
how: Cut a quartz crystal to vibrate at 32,768 Hz.
Divide that rate in a circuit down to one pulse each second.
Drive a stepping motor or a display with each pulse.

origin.note: Warren Marrison builds the first quartz clock at Bell Telephone Laboratories.

adoptions.via: The Astron puts a quartz crystal in a wristwatch, and the quartz watch with digits follows.
The Swatch uses a quartz module of few parts, so that the watch is cheap and exact.
